channel.title: OmniKey AI releases
channel.description: New features, fixes, and improvements in OmniKey AI.

item.title: New blog: I Gave My Keyboard Shortcut a Terminal and a Browser
item.description: Five example workflows using OmniAgent with terminal access, authenticated browser sessions, and MCP integrations, plus permission and safety guidance.

item.title: OmniKey v1.8.22
item.description:

  • Publish 1.8.21 and macOS 1.9.21 changelog
